mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of haloperidol-induced QT prolongation and arrhythmias; both drugs have anticholinergic effects and CNS depression potential.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, obtain baseline and periodic ECGs, consider alternative antipsychotic if possible, and maintain adequate potassium supplementation.
